items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willie’s a brother... They all played music... Me and Willie would get up six o’clock in the morning and walk around the South Side.

ctx.x: The Barbarin family is one of the most popular names in New Orleans music with names like Paul and Louis and Isidore. How is your mother related to them?

That’s her brothers you call. Paul’s a brother. Willie’s a brother. Lucien’s a brother. Paul, Willie, Lucien, and Louis. They all played music, because my whole family . . . We were encouraged to play music, because it added to the poor folk’s moneybag. It added a little money more to the . . . You played as a extra to your regular job, whatever you . . . was your profession or your trade. Mostly your trade. By playing music, you added on weekends or anytime, you added to the moneybags in the family.
So it was an honor to be a musician.
